notes.subject: ol bikman bilong en
notes.rationale: סריסים: literal em i ol man i no gat samting moa (eunuk), tasol ol tanim tok olsem 'ol ofisa bilong king' (KJV) — hia mipela holim pasin bilong bikman bilong haus king

notes.subject: kisim ten pat long
notes.rationale: עשר literal em i 'tanim tok bilong ten' — kisim ten pat; Tok Pisin i no gat tok bilong taith

translation: Na bai em kisim ten pat long kaikai pikinini bilong yupela na long ol gaden wain bilong yupela, na givim long ol bikman bilong en na long ol wokman bilong en.

tokens.gloss: na long ol wokman bilong en
